components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one decisive action in view (Connect, Start sandbox).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #52a8ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--text, #ededed); color: var(--bg, #0a0a0a); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The workhorse action button (events, setup, pairing).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #ededed); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #52a8ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--surface-2, #171717); border-color: var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-3, #1f1f1f); border-color: #4a4a4a; } .ds-kbd { font: 0.6875rem/1 var(--mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); color: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); padding: 3px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-2, #171717); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Inline low-stakes actions: Copy, creature set, stepper.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #52a8ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost { color: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text, #ededed); background: var(--surface-3, #1f1f1f); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Binary setting; 36x20 track inside a 52x44 hit area, Signal Blue when on.
components.html: <button class="ds-switch" type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Contour lines" onclick="this.setAttribute('aria-checked', this.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true')"></button>
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 44px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-3, #1f1f1f); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-switch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 15px; left: 11px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true']::before { background: var(--accent, #52a8ff); border-color: var(--accent, #52a8ff); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='true']::after { transform: translateX(16px); background: #0a0a0a; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #52a8ff); outline-offset: -4px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Segmented Theme Picker
components.description: Recessed radio group; options carry a swatch strip from the real terrain palette.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px; padding: 2px; width: 360px; background: var(--bg, #0a0a0a); border: 1px solid var(--border, #262626); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; font: 500 0.8125rem/1 var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--text, #ededed); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #52a8ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked='true'] { background: var(--surface-3, #1f1f1f); color: var(--text, #ededed); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-sw { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 56px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Top-bar health indicator; dot plus words, tinted for warn/err.
components.html: Sensor: Kinect v2 Sensor: waiting Disconnected
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 0.8125rem/1 var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); border: 1px solid var(--border, #262626); border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-3, #8a8a8a); } .ds-status[data-tone='ok'] .ds-dot { background: var(--ok, #3fcf8e); } .ds-status[data-tone='warn'] { color: var(--warn, #f5a524); border-color: rgba(245,165,36,0.35); } .ds-status[data-tone='warn'] .ds-dot { background: var(--warn, #f5a524); } .ds-status[data-tone='err'] { color: var(--err, #ff6166); border-color: rgba(255,97,102,0.35); } .ds-status[data-tone='err'] .ds-dot { background: var(--err, #ff6166); }

components.name: Control Group
components.description: Hairline panel of 52px rows grouped by job; key-cap hint revealed on hover/focus.
components.html:
World
Contour lines COn
Sound SOff
components.css: .ds-group { margin: 0; width: 360px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 4px 16px 12px; background: var(--surface, #111111); border: 1px solid var(--border, #262626); border-radius: 8px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #ededed); } .ds-group-title { float: left; width: 100%; padding: 12px 0 4px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-row { clear: both; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 52px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #262626); } .ds-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-row-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-row-value { color: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); } .ds-kbd { visibility: hidden; font: 0.6875rem/1 var(--mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); color: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); padding: 3px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-2, #171717); } .ds-row:hover .ds-kbd, .ds-row:focus-within .ds-kbd { visibility: visible; }

components.name: PIN Input
components.description: Recessed field; Mono numerals with wide tracking; accent border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 320px; } .ds-field-label { font: 400 0.8125rem/1.5 var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); } .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 1.25rem/1 var(--mono, 'Geist Mono', monospace); letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--text, #ededed); background: var(--bg, #0a0a0a); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #52a8ff); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--accent, #52a8ff); }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Sticky bar: brand mark and wordmark left, status pills and one secondary action right.
components.html: DuneBoxConnected
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 24px; background: rgba(10,10,10,0.92); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #262626); color: var(--text, #ededed); font-family: var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-pill { margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text-2, #a1a1a1); border: 1px solid var(--border, #262626); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok, #3fcf8e); } .ds-tb-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 inherit; font-family: inherit; color: var(--text, #ededed); background: var(--surface-2, #171717); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tb-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-3, #1f1f1f); } .ds-tb-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #52a8ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-right notification led by a status dot; slides up 8px on entry.
components.html:
Snapshot saved.
Sensor unplugged. Replug the Kinect, then press Retry.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; width: 340px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #ededed); background: var(--surface-2, #171717); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); animation: ds-toast-in 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-toast::before { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok, #3fcf8e); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-toast[data-tone='err'] { border-color: rgba(255,97,102,0.45); } .ds-toast[data-tone='err']::before { background: var(--err, #ff6166); } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-toast { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
DuneBox's operator surfaces are a console, not a show. The sand under the projector is the spectacle; every screen an adult touches is calm, near-black, and legible at arm's length in a dim room, so it never competes with the projection. The direction is the category standard played straight (chosen by Max, 2026-10-03): a crisp dark product UI held to the craft level of Vercel and Linear. No themed or novelty world; no sand textures, no topo-line decoration in the chrome.

Density is moderate and job-grouped. The live sand view leads on the left with four honest facts beneath it; the right column holds controls grouped by job (World, Events, Games, Setup, DuneBox C++), each a hairline-bordered panel of 52px rows. Depth comes from stepped neutral layers, not shadows; color carries meaning only. A single blue says "on" or "selected"; green, amber and red say healthy, attention, broken, always paired with words.

The same tokens drive three surfaces: the web dashboard (the normative source, `web/assets/app.css`), the pygame settings sidebar, and the C++ ofxDatGui panel. When one of the native surfaces can't express a rule, it degrades toward the nearest honest equivalent described under Components, never toward a different look.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black neutral layers (five steps from page to raised control) with 1px hairline borders.
One blue accent, reserved for on/selected state and focus.
Geist for all UI text; Geist Mono only for measurements, PINs, URLs and key caps.
Flat at rest; shadows only on floating layers (popovers, toasts) and the selected segment.
Motion is short and functional (150–220ms, one ease-out curve), and drops away under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue means "this is on, selected, or focused" and nothing else. If an element isn't stateful, it isn't blue.

rules.name: The Words-With-Color Rule
rules.body: Every status hue ships with text that says the same thing ("Sensor: waiting", "Can't reach the sandbox."). A dot alone is never the message.

rules.name: The Real Palette Exception
rules.body: The only multi-hue color on screen is the theme swatch strip in the World group, which is generated from the sandbox's actual terrain palette data. It is evidence, not decoration; never hand-pick hues for it.

rules.name: The Measured-Value Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono with tabular figures for anything that is a number from the system, a PIN, a URL or a key; Geist for everything a human wrote. Never set prose in Mono.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Section titles are body-size at 600. Don't escalate headings in size to create hierarchy inside the control column.

rules.name: The Arm's-Length Rule
rules.body: Interactive hit areas are never below 44px (`spacing.target`), and control rows are 52px. A switch's visible track is 36×20 inside a 52×44 hit area.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No colored shadows, no blur halos, no backdrop-filter glass. Depth is tone plus hairline; a shadow is always black and only under something that floats.

rules.name: The Nesting Rule
rules.body: Radius steps down as you go inward: 8 for the container, 6 for the control, 4 for the part inside the control.

dos: **Do** let the live sand view lead the first viewport; controls sit beside it, grouped by job.
**Do** step neutrals for depth: `bg` page, `surface` panel, `surface-2` raised, `surface-3` pressed, and recess wells back to `bg`.
**Do** use Signal Blue only for on, selected and focus (`:focus-visible` is a 2px `accent` outline, 2px offset).
**Do** pair every status color with text, and write error copy that names the fix.
**Do** set every system number, PIN, URL and key in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
**Do** keep hit areas at 44px and control rows at 52px on every surface, native panels included.
**Do** use the single ease-out curve `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` at 150ms for color/border changes, 200–220ms for movement, and drop movement under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** keep Geist and Geist Mono vendored locally; the dashboard must work offline.
donts: **Don't** build an admin-template stat-card grid; facts live in one hairline strip under the view.
**Don't** add glow, colored shadows, gradients on chrome, or backdrop-filter glass.
**Don't** introduce a second accent or use status hues decoratively.
**Don't** hand-pick theme swatch colors; they come from the sandbox's real palettes.
**Don't** show a control the connected app can't honor; hide it or disable its group with an explanation.
**Don't** rely on hover to reveal anything essential; key-cap hints are the only hover reveal and they vanish on touch.
**Don't** theme the operator UI with sand, terrain or novelty motifs; the projection owns that.
**Don't** swap Geist for another face to satisfy an overused-font warning; it was chosen deliberately.
